method: Rendered newly authored SVGs through PyMuPDF and actually viewed each resulting PNG using view_image. Corrected label overlaps, hidden-foot toe ambiguity, frame scale, muzzle envelope and missing fixed clapper hanger; re-rendered and viewed final changed images.
observations: Center section separates the shell, fixed crown hanger, hinged internal clapper and open carrier from the body. Saddle station shows an actual pad cut rather than projected pads.
Four body views share one construction source. Front/back branch handedness is explicit; far legs are hidden outlines rather than extra visible toe sets. Every visible front/back paw shows four toes.
Gait contact charts have leg IDs, three stance contacts and one swing contact. Frame height and limb path now use the same side-view scale.
Diagrams are simple proposed mass envelopes. The illustrated master remains the target for animal expression, bark and moss forms.
limitations: No model, rig or normal-speed animation was viewed.
